lines.base_translation: Ha ha...Bwah ha ha ha! [02]Olha so a turba la embaixo! Parece formiga! Inseto! Bwah ha ha ha ha!

lines.text_source: "We caught someone trying[01]to sneak into the castle.[02]I'd keep my distance if I[01]were you!"

lines.text_source: "I heard tell that belonged[01]to the King himself!"
